theme: An open Sunday with a short board review and a pile of overdue travel bookings.
greeting: The whole day is yours, Dan — one short call with Mike at nine, then open water. A good day to clear the bookings that keep sliding.

needsAttention.detail: Flagged top-priority in Todoist and marked "book this week" — a full-size holiday SUV out of PWM is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; open since mid-September. Book refundable now.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December trip — window closes Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: The December-break task sets book-by Oct 15, four days out; all four girls, Dec 13 – Jan 2, and holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year.

needsAttention.title: The Pathfinder drive south is this week
needsAttention.detail: The Portland → St Pete window is Oct 5 – 18 — the off-week between girl-weeks; it replaces a flight, so book the hotel night once dates are set.

needsAttention.title: Pick the spot for lunch with Fran
needsAttention.detail: She's good with sushi "only if it's cooked," so it's down to confirming Miyake or Isa Bistro at 12:30 Friday.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15 min — empty the inbox, owner + date on everything, chase what's waiting.
